bull_case: Axon-driven share gains extend beyond gaming into e-commerce and CTV while FCF/share compounds rapidly. The locked Bull path reaches $55/share in year 10 and supports value far above the frozen price.
bear_case: Growth decelerates sharply as ad platforms respond, privacy rules tighten and current margins prove near peak. FCF/share stagnates around the mid-teens, leaving material downside.
thesis: At $321.60, APP trades below the locked Base DCF of about $429 and far below Bull of about $772. The discount is meaningful, but valuation still assumes durable high margins and double-digit FCF/share growth from an unusually profitable starting point. Current price does not require a Bull-plus outcome. Base value is moderately terminal-dependent, so competitive durability and margin normalization remain the central valuation risks.

evidence.claim: Frozen close is $321.60; latest outstanding shares are 334.651M, implying market cap about $107.62B.
evidence.source: ChartExchange historical close and uploaded Q2 10-Q share count

evidence.claim: FY2025 revenue was $5.481B, up 70%, and FCF was $3.952B.
FY2026 H1 revenue rose 56% to $3.766B and FCF was $2.150B.
Q3 guidance calls for $2.055B-$2.085B revenue and about 83% adjusted EBITDA margin.
Locked owner-FCF/share DCF yields Bear/Base/Bull values about $166.86/$429.37/$771.95, with price/Base about 0.749x.

counterevidence: Current operating and adjusted-EBITDA margins are already extraordinary, so a Base path can fail through margin normalization even if revenue grows.
Advertising technology is exposed to platform-policy, privacy and regulatory shifts controlled partly by Apple, Google and governments.
The Base DCF remains meaningfully dependent on terminal value, so long-run competitive durability matters more than near-term growth.
The 5-year valuation percentile is not frozen on a consistent metric, limiting relative-valuation evidence.
unknowns: Long-run Axon-driven share gains outside gaming.
Steady-state operating margin after competitors respond.
Five-year valuation percentile on a consistent EV/FCF metric.

uncertainties.rationale: Current price is below a reasonable Base path rather than requiring Bull-plus assumptions.
Base upside is meaningful but depends on sustained FCF/share growth from elevated margins.
Terminal value and competitive durability remain important to long-duration value.

falsifiers: FCF/share stalls while revenue grows because margins normalize faster than expected.
Axon share gains reverse across multiple customer verticals.
A revised realistic Bull FCF path falls below the frozen price.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Frozen price is below locked Base and well below Bull; Bull-plus assumptions are not required.

key_kpis.name: FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: Sustain double-digit per-share compounding over multi-year periods

key_kpis.name: Revenue growth / margin
key_kpis.threshold: Growth remains strong without severe margin compression

key_kpis.name: Share count
key_kpis.threshold: Repurchases continue to offset SBC and reduce diluted shares

next_checks: Evidence of e-commerce/CTV scale outside gaming.

subscores.rationale: Current price can be justified by a strong but not heroic FCF path.
Locked Base value is about one-third above the frozen price.
Valuation survives moderate assumptions but still depends on durable margins and terminal value.
